products.name: Sonnet Twin10G SFP28 PCIe Card
products.summary: Dual-port optical 10GbE PCIe card that ships with two short-range multimode SFP28 transceivers (up to 300 m).
products.description: The Sonnet Twin10G SFP28 PCIe Card (G10E-SFP-2XM-E3) adds two optical 10GbE ports to Mac Pro, Windows and Linux computers and servers. It includes two short-range multimode SFP28 transceivers rated to 300 m that work with SFP+-equipped switches over standard LC/LC cabling.

products.name: Sonnet Solo2.5G USB-C to 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet Adapter
products.summary: Compact USB-C to 2.5GBASE-T adapter for Mac, Windows, Linux, Chromebook and iPad with USB-C or Thunderbolt ports.
products.description: The Sonnet Solo2.5G (SOLO-NBASE-T) adds an RJ45 port with 2.5 Gb/s NBASE-T support over existing Cat 5e cabling to Mac, Windows, Chromebook and Linux computers and USB-C or Thunderbolt iPads, falling back to slower link speeds on older switches.

products.name: Protectli Vault Pro VP6650
products.summary: Six-port Vault Pro with Intel Core i5-1235U, 2 x 10GbE SFP+ and 4 x 2.5GbE, up to 96 GB DDR5 and coreboot support.
products.description: The Vault Pro VP6650 pairs an Intel Core i5-1235U (10 cores / 12 threads, up to 4.4 GHz) with two Intel 10GbE SFP+ and four Intel 2.5GbE ports. It takes up to 96 GB DDR5-4800 in SO-DIMMs, one M.2 NVMe SSD and two 2.5-inch SATA SSDs, and uses built-in fans that run only as needed plus a 120 W power supply.
